description: This file is a module that imports several Vue components related to various UI states or error messages (e.g., 'NoRecordsFound', 'BadRequest') and exports an object mapping string keys to these components. It serves as a centralized component registry for handling different display states within the application.

methods.name: default export (the exported object)
methods.description: Exports an object mapping string keys to corresponding imported Vue components, used to render different states/views.
